jobs.description:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Technical Project Manager

Salary

$60k-$80k

Company Description

StrataBlue is an AI-first digital agency with over 18 years of experience building AI-powered marketing, sales, and operational systems for mid-market companies.

Job Description

You will own projects end-to-end, serving as the bridge between technical execution and client strategy. By designing complex workflows and leading development sprints, you’ll ensure the delivery of high-impact AI automation solutions. This role requires a hands-on builder capable of translating business requirements into scalable, automated architectures that drive significant revenue for clients.

Location

Remote

Why this role is remarkable

Work at the cutting edge of AI automation, building real-world solutions in tools like n8n and Make rather than just managing tickets.
Join an established 18-year-old agency that has successfully pivoted to an AI-first model, delivering systems that have generated over $11M in sales for clients.
Enjoy high autonomy and direct reporting to the Managing Partner in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your contributions have immediate impact.

What You Will Do

Design and document sophisticated business processes and workflow architectures to be implemented within AI-powered systems.
Manage distributed development teams through daily standups, sprint planning, and rigorous QA to ensure high-quality technical delivery.
Lead client-facing engagements, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and maintaining trust throughout the project lifecycle.

The ideal candidate

3-7 years of experience in technical project management, specifically within an agency or consultancy environment managing offshore development teams.
Hands-on proficiency with AI automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier and advanced workflow management tools like ClickUp.
Self-motivated and action-oriented professional with a strong customer service mindset and the ability to work independently during EST business hours.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
TO APPLY (REQUIRED):

Please submit your resume and a cover letter to careers@planningcommunities.com. Applications will not be considered without this requirement.

Planning Communities is a women-owned, certified B-Corporation that specializes in socially and environmentally responsible planning and geospatial services. We combine systems thinking with innovative tools, interactive GIS, and data driven strategies to tackle complex challenges in human-centered mobility and transit, climate and carbon resilience, and conservation and connectivity. Our impact-driven approach supports equitable, sustainable communities through planning, spatial insight, and inclusive engagement, balancing the needs of people, place, and planet.

We are searching for an experienced, highly qualified Project Manager to help us manage a growing portfolio of projects, including several large, high-complexity engagements, as an innovative, values-driven company. This is a lead role and the ideal candidate has experience as a project manager for a small firm or consultancy, is comfortable owning several concurrent projects of significant scale and budget and can operate with a high degree of independence on both delivery and the business side of project management, including budget tracking and monthly invoicing. The Project Manager will work with a distributed team of staff and consultants, lead client and stakeholder relationships, and report directly to the Chief Operations Officer, taking on a broad scope of financial and portfolio-level visibility.

Objectives of this role

• Independently lead multiple concurrent projects, including large-scale engagements, typically, in the $150,000–$300,000+ range, from requirements definition through deployment, identifying schedules, scopes, budget estimations, and implementation plans, including risk mitigation.
• Ensure that projects adhere to scope, schedule, and budget; proactively revise or replan as needed without close oversight.
• Work with the firm's accountant for processing invoices, ensure progress reports are complete and include % to bill, answer questions about work completed, ensuring accurate, on-time client invoicing and coordinating with firm leadership on revenue and utilization targets.
• Establish and maintain relationships with relevant client stakeholders, providing day-to-day contact on project status and changes.
• Collaborate with team members to improve project approaches and methodologies and engage in peer learning.
• Bring new and creative subject matter, business ideas, and product ideas that are in alignment with B-Corp principles.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning and Initiation:
• Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to define project scopes, objectives, deliverables, timelines, and budgets.
• Develop project plans, including tasks, sub-tasks, budgets, and timelines, for projects of varying scale, including large, multi-phase engagements.
• Work with firm leadership and the team to identify and assign team members to projects, clearly communicating roles and responsibilities.
Project Execution, Financial Management, and Monitoring:
• Lead and contribute to all aspects of assigned projects, whether managing, supporting, or executing, by delivering high quality, creative work aligned with project goals.
• Track project progress against the plan, identifying potential roadblocks and proactively addressing issues.
• Monitor project budgets and profitability, adjusting scope or resourcing as necessary to maintain financial viability.
• Manage the monthly invoicing process for assigned projects: prepare, review, and submit accurate client invoices on schedule, and track receivables in coordination with firm leadership.
• Facilitate effective communication between team members, stakeholders, and clients through regular status updates and meetings.
• Report project outcomes, financial status, and risks to firm leadership and escalate issues as necessary.
• Support the execution of changes and updates to improve the company’s project management and invoicing systems.
• Lead cross-functional QA/QC efforts to ensure high quality and integrity of all deliverables.

Partnership and Stakeholder Management

• Build strong relationships with key partners and stakeholders (including vendors), managing expectations and addressing concerns promptly.
• Regularly communicate project status and financial updates to firm leadership and clients.
• Proactively identify and mitigate potential risks to project success and to the firm’s revenue targets.

Quality Assurance and Delivery

• Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and adhere to established requirements.
• Participate in project closeout activities, including documentation, final reports, financial reconciliation, and lessons learned analysis.

Team Development:

• Contribute to and cultivate a collaborative and supportive team environment.
• Encourage and contribute to cross-functional teamwork and knowledge sharing within the project
team.
• Mentor junior project staff and consultants on project management practices as the team grows.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in planning, environmental policy, sustainability, climate resilience, decarbonization, or a related field, with a minimum of 7–10 years of combined relevant planning and project management experience.
• Demonstrated experience managing project management operations at a small firm or consultancy, including running multiple concurrent projects, owning budgets, and hitting revenue/invoicing targets, not solely large-institution project experience.
• Proven track record independently managing several large, complex projects simultaneously (budgets of $150,000–$300,000+) without close supervision.
• Hands-on experience with monthly client invoicing, budget tracking, and revenue reporting in a professional services or consulting environment.
• Subject matter expertise in one or more of these priority areas: climate and carbon resilience; conservation and connectivity planning and human-centered mobility and net zero transit planning.
• Demonstrated ability to independently research and analyze complex issues to develop practical, data-driven solutions for diverse planning and community challenges.
• Strong project management skills, including facilitation, research, and developing plans and products.
• Excellent communication and people skills to effectively collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
• Ability to prioritize across a high volume of concurrent projects, manage deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities under real workload pressure.
• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify and resolve project issues.
• Strong attention to deadlines and budgetary guidelines.
• Proficiency in project management software tools (e.g., Scoro, Basecamp, Asana, Trello, Microsoft Project, etc.).
• Understanding of GIS and geospatial technologies and experience collaborating with professionals in this sector to integrate and deliver GIS products and services.
• Understanding of design concepts for websites and GIS applications (e.g., hub sites, surveys) to help guide team developers who build these out.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills and excellent presentation skills.
• Ability to wear multiple hats and contribute to cross-functional initiatives as needed within a small team, while maintaining sustainable workload management.

Preferred skills and qualifications

• Professional certification(s) such as AICP, PMP, GISP and/or other related certifications.
• Experience working with a small firm and/or certified B-Corp company

Position Details

• Job Type: Full-time, remote work location based in the US.
• Pay: $110,000–$130,000 per year, commensurate with experience.
• Schedule: Monday to Friday, with occasional weekday or weekend travel required.
• Travel: Ability to travel as needed to client locations for meetings, etc. Estimated 20%–25% annually.

Benefits

• Health, dental, and vision insurance (effective the 1st of the month following the start date).
• Paid Time Off (PTO) accrued at a rate of 10.67 hours per month, or 16 days per year for full-time employment.
• Paid holidays, including a Wellness Day and Floating Holiday.
• 401(k) retirement plan with company match on the first 3% of employee contributions.
• Company-paid life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage.
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and access to supplemental benefits.
• Opportunities for professional development, including certifications and affiliations.
• Work with a certified B-Corp purpose-driven organization.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Technical Program Manager

Location: Kansas City metro (hybrid)
Type: Full-time
Reports to the Founder & CEO
Compensation: $115k-$145k; Travel Required

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Cyber 429 delivers enterprise-grade security and compliance programs with a deliberately small, senior team. Our active portfolio spans multi-year, multi-workstream framework remediation programs (NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171/CMMC, SOX ITGC) for enterprise clients, physical security assessments, vCISO engagements at multiple institutions, a student-powered SOC, and two annual security events. The CEO leads these programs. Your job is to make sure nothing under them slips: every deliverable tracked, every dependency visible, every status report accurate, every client seeing a program that simply runs. This is not a coordinator role. You will own the operating system of our delivery practice and represent it directly to client executives and leadership teams.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

•    Program execution —
run the integrated project plans, workstream schedules, dependency maps, and milestone tracking for all active client programs; surface schedule risk before it becomes slippage.
•    Systems of record —
own the POA&M registers, risk registers, control trackers (NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171/CMMC, SOX ITGC), and evidence libraries that serve as each program's system of record; keep them current weekly, not quarterly.
•    Governance cadence —
produce the weekly written status, monthly executive readouts, and board/audit-committee-ready reporting packages; maintain decision logs, action trackers, and rolling document request lists for every engagement.
•    Atlassian platform —
administer and continuously improve our Jira/Confluence program workspaces and dashboards; build the templates, automations, and intake workflows that let a small team run enterprise-grade programs.
•    Deliverable lifecycle —
manage the pipeline of client deliverables through drafting, internal QA, client review cycles, and formal acceptance; enforce the review SLAs we commit to in engagement letters.
•    Vendor and stakeholder accountability —
track partner-delivered and client-internal workstreams against their commitments; prepare the accountability materials our engagement leads use to keep vendors and internal owners on schedule.
•    Client-side orchestration —
coordinate client counterparts, site SPOCs, interview schedules, DRL collection, and travel logistics for on-site work including physical security assessments.
•    Commercial hygiene —
keep engagement scope, assumptions, and fee milestones aligned with what is actually being delivered; flag scope creep and change-order triggers early; support invoicing against milestones.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE

•    Every active program has a current integrated plan, register, and dashboard a client executive could read cold and trust.
•    Weekly status ships on time, every week, without the CEO writing it.
•    Zero deliverables missed for reasons we could see coming; dependencies and blockers escalated with runway to act.
•    Partner-delivered and client-internal workstreams tracked to the same standard as our own — with the documentation to prove it.
•    A repeatable program playbook (templates, workflows, cadences) that lets Cyber 429 onboard the next enterprise client without reinventing anything.

WHAT YOU BRING

•    8+ years of technical program or project management, including 3+ years running multi-workstream programs for external clients (consulting, MSSP, or professional services strongly preferred).
•    Working fluency in security and compliance frameworks — NIST 800-53/800-171, CMMC, SOX ITGC — enough to speak credibly about controls, evidence, and remediation without an interpreter.
•    Deep, hands-on Jira and Confluence skills: workflows, dashboards, automation, and structure design — you build the workspace, not just live in it.
•    Executive-grade written communication. Your status reports, readouts, and meeting notes go to CIOs, CFOs, and audit committees as-is.
•    Composure and follow-through in ambiguity: you close loops, chase owners, and escalate with judgment rather than waiting to be told.
•    PMP, PgMP, or equivalent scar tissue. CISSP, CISA, CISM, or Security+ a plus. Prior work in regulated or compliance-heavy environments a plus.
•    Kansas City metro based or willing to relocate; periodic travel to client sites (roughly monthly during active assessment windows).
•    Currently or previously held a US Security Clearance a plus; applicants must be eligible to obtain a US Security clearance

HOW WE WORK

Cyber 429 is a bootstrapped, founder-led security firm with an intelligence-community DNA and a “fans, not customers” standard for client experience. We serve organizations from regulated enterprises to colleges, schools, and under-resourced institutions, and we operate with the urgency that mission implies. Small team, no bureaucracy, high trust, high accountability. You will see the whole business, sit close to the CEO, and your work will be visible to client leadership within your first month.

COMPENSATION

Base salary of $115,000–$145,000 depending on experience, plus an annual performance bonus of up to 10% tied to program milestone delivery and client retention. Health benefits, and the standard Cyber 429 flexibility that comes with being trusted to run your own calendar. Other benefits come with this role and which we will discuss during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Primary Objective

Reporting to the Head of Operations – WA (north west), the Senior Project Manager is responsible for the safe, compliant and commercially successful delivery of assigned projects across the Pilbara. The position provides hands-on leadership across the full project lifecycle, including tender handover, planning, mobilisation, execution, commissioning, handover and close-out.

The Senior Project Manager is accountable for all general project management functions, including health and safety, scope, schedule, cost, commercial management, quality, risk, resourcing, client engagement, reporting and compliance. A key focus of the role is driving project performance through disciplined planning, effective management of Primavera P6 schedules, strong financial and commercial controls, and accurate and timely project reporting.

The position is based in Perth but will operate predominantly from project sites across the Pilbara.

Principal Duties/Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery

Lead the planning, mobilisation, execution and close-out of assigned projects.
Extensive experience delivering shutdowns for a contractor (balance machines would be highly regarded)
Take overall accountability for the safe, timely, compliant and commercially successful delivery of projects.
Develop and implement project execution plans that clearly define scope, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones and performance expectations.
Ensure project objectives are aligned with Company requirements, contractual obligations and client expectations.
Coordinate project resources, subcontractors, suppliers and internal support functions.
Provide visible, hands-on leadership across site-based project activities.
Monitor project performance and take timely corrective action where delivery is not meeting agreed expectations.
Identify constraints and implement recovery strategies to protect project milestones and commercial outcomes.
Manage commissioning, handover, completion documentation, demobilisation and project close-out activities.
Conduct post-project reviews and ensure lessons learned are captured and applied to future projects.

Primavera P6 Planning and Scheduling

jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
This position is in Santa Rosa, in the heart of California’s beautiful wine country, is the corporate headquarters of Keysight, home to many product development R&D labs. The Digital and Photonics R&D team in Santa Rosa develops and produces the world’s highest performance oscilloscopes.
You will work in close collaboration with a diverse multi-functional team of engineers, scientists, and researchers around the globe to meet the communications electronics measurement challenges of today and tomorrow. Giving customers insight into developing digital communication and Internet infrastructure signals and devices is our focus. Keysight is committed to providing innovative measurement solutions that enable our customers and partners to deliver the products and services that make a measurable difference in the lives of people everywhere.
Responsibilities

Lead and develop a team of multi-talented hardware engineers to invent, design, and develop new, world-leading time-domain measurement instruments, working with a multi-functional, global team to deliver designs from concept to full manufacturing shipment.
Quickly learn the hardware architecture of sampling oscilloscopes, taking ownership to imagine, define, plan and execute one or more projects to deliver new oscilloscope products to market. Instrument design requires multiple subsystem integration including optical and electrical frontends, signal sampling sub-systems, clock recovery/phase lock loop design at frequencies from 20 GHz to 200GHz with analog control/sensing/adjustment circuitry. Provide customer-valued performance, robustness, and flexibility within cost, schedule and scope constraints.
Lead a multi-functional team through the full product development lifecycle and prove your designs are manufacturable as well as high-performance. Work to balance customer-facing requirements with pragmatic technical judgement to align on scope, factory cost/investment cost, and schedule. Learn and follow the Keysight product lifecycle, respecting standards of business conduct and export control restrictions.
Collaborate with sampling scope, OF NPI and DP-COE leadership team. Sampling scopes is a fast-paced, dynamic team where hardware and software operating managers who collaborate to efficiently complete multiple synergistic new product introductions. Work extensively with customer-facing inbound marketing, field sales force, Keysight Labs, and a leader of our large global manufacturing organization.
Grow engineering talent. Evaluate, coach and reward to maximize individual performance and support the success of our sampling R&D teams
Support customers. Present technical information of value to customers, occasionally visiting global customer sites to present products and help customers with integration
In a dynamically changing technology environment, continuous learning is expected and supported throughout your career.

Qualifications

This position requires significant electronic product knowledge to understand the hardware and make timely design and execution path risk tradeoff decisions. Relevant technical background of a successful candidate most likely to be in electrical or mechanical engineering with significant project execution experience.
Open to individuals with a track record of leading engineering teams to deliver projects involving new electronic and mechanical design within time/cost/scope constraints. Educational background most likely includes a BS or MS degree in an Engineering major or equivalent field of study with 2-4 years of related project leadership experience to draw upon.
One or more examples of project leadership. Ability to discuss performance, cost, and schedule tradeoffs, arrive at an aligned execution plan & track progress. One or more examples of how changes to plan were handled.
Evidence of excellent leadership of triage & troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.
Enjoy working with a diverse multi-functional team to deliver prototype designs into volume manufacturing on a global scale. Evidence of talent development skills & optimizing team productivity and creativity
Demonstration of excellent communication and teamwork skills, enjoying working with a diverse and global team Ability to persuasively advocate for resources to remove roadblocks to speed project execution
Strong problem-solving and quantitative data analysis skills. Evidence of experience with budget management, factory cost versus net profit versus product scope tradeoffs in a quantitative data-driven analysis.
Ability to quickly learn new technologies
Excellent time management, and ability to work independently in supportive team of available mentors

Significant pluses:

Evidence of ability to lead strategic discussions, for example future roadmap development. Evidence of ability to make crisp and accurate tactical decisions with incomplete/ambiguous information, and then articulately explain & recruit support.
Ability to quickly learn to correctly set up optical and electrical measuring instruments to demonstrate and test the desired measurement. Enjoys hands-on exploration to find correct instrument setups to evaluate your software/hardware integration quality
Evidence of handling new IP protection, and export control requirements. Ability to persuasively represent technical expertise to end-use customers is highly desired
Specific examples of high-risk tradeoff decisions and ability to explain the method by which the decision was made

Other Information

This position is on-site in Santa Rosa, California
Relocation is available for this position

jobs.description:

Description

The Opportunity

KWI keeps specialty retail running for Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and dozens of other brands, and behind every storefront is an engineering team shipping constantly. Today those releases are coordinated on instinct and hallway conversations. You're here to change that. As our Technical Program Manager, you'll own the master release timeline, build the system that keeps every team aligned, and make shipping shorter, smoother, and more predictable, reporting straight to the CTO with a clear mandate to fix what slows us down.

The Company

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a unified commerce solution that is designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford, and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, eCommerce, CRM, and Loss Prevention into one cloud-based platform. We are a Values and Mission driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

As the Technical Program Manager, you excel at the following core competencies

Cross-team release coordination
Own the master release timeline across all engineering teams, with a particular focus on the POS release cycle.
Map and track cross-team dependencies; surface conflicts early and drive resolution before they become delays. Facilitate go/no-go checkpoints.
You can approve a go based on readiness data; all no-go decisions escalate to the CTO and Head of Product.
Manage the release calendar so teams on different schedules do not collide. Establish and enforce change control: once scope is locked, late changes require formal approval with an impact assessment

Cross-functional coordination
Define and maintain RACI matrices for release activities across Engineering, QA, Technical Writing, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Run release readiness reviews that include all involved departments, not just engineering.
Serve as the single point of accountability for program-level release status visibility across the organization.

Risk management and escalation
Proactively identify risks to timelines, scope, and quality across all teams.
Maintain a risk register and drive mitigation plans.
Escalate to the CTO and Head of Product when cross-team conflicts cannot be resolved at the team level.

The impact you'll make

Process definition and documentation
Convert tribal knowledge into documented, repeatable processes: release runbooks, checklists, onboarding guides.
Define and maintain the release process end-to-end so it is survivable if any individual is unavailable.
Establish templates for cross-team planning: dependency maps, risk registers, status reports.
Identify bottlenecks and gaps; propose and implement improvements using retrospective data.

Reporting and continuous improvement
Design and own the organization-wide status reporting system: template, cadence, format, and a compilation mechanism so the report assembles itself.
Author program-level status reports directly covering cross-team releases, dependency health, risks, and milestones.
Partner with engineering leadership to mature delivery practices and introduce tooling that improves velocity and visibility.
Establish program-level metrics (cycle time, release predictability, dependency-related delays) and use them to drive improvement.

What you will bring

5 to 9 years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a comparable role coordinating across multiple engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build and run release coordination at the program level, not just within a single team or project.
Strong technical fluency: you can hold a substantive conversation about architecture, dependencies, and technical risk without needing it simplified for you.
Experience defining and documenting processes from scratch, including runbooks, RACI matrices, and dependency tracking frameworks.
Track record of managing cross-functional stakeholders, including product, QA, marketing, and customer success, through complex releases.
Clear written communication: your status reports give leadership the information they need to make decisions, not a list of what everyone is working on.

Bonus points
Experience in a SaaS company serving retail or enterprise clients.
Familiarity with Kanban-based delivery workflows and how to mature them into more disciplined frameworks.
Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted workflows for delivery visibility or reporting.
Background working closely with a CTO or VP Engineering in a fast-moving product organization.

As a member of the KWI team you will receive

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee base salary)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

Our work space

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a state-of-the-art coffee machine, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

Our commitment to you

At KWI, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. We create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.

With a commitment to maintaining a bias-free environment in which harassment is prohibited, we respect cultural diversity and comply with the laws of the places in which we operate. We expect our business partners, suppliers, clients, and all our team members to uphold these commitments.

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

This is a full-time role working 37.5 hours per week. On offer is a competitive salary, company vehicle or allowance and benefits package.

As part of the Project Management team you will take full accountability for the delivery of Variations and Life Cycle projects across the PFI site.

What will you deliver?

Manage the P&L and H&S for your projects from concept to completion with the support from the Lead PM and Head of Projects

Support the wider Project, Life cycle and operational teams to ensure all work is carried out on time & to budget
Manage the team and ensure that there is continuity of service during staff absences/holidays
Ensure on time delivery and margin optimisation is achieved for all projects

25 days annual leave (+ public holidays)

Employee discount shopping schemes on major brands and retailers
Gym membership discounts
Cycle to work scheme

Broad range of learning opportunities, such as professional qualifications, collective/individual training, and personalized support programmes

jobs.description:
Overview

Agency Summary

The purpose and mission of the Department of Business & Neighborhood Services (DBNS) is to protect and improve the quality of life of persons and animals in the City of Indianapolis. DBNS is the City of Indianapolis and Marion County’s principal department responsible for business licenses, residential and commercial permits, and the enforcement of the Revised Code of Ordinances of the Consolidated City and County.

Job Summary

Position is responsible for performing supervisory duties for employees and processes related to permitting, inspections, and enforcement operations and ensuring compliance with floodplain, stormwater, sediment control, transportation standards and more. Incumbent will be responsible for staff assignments, trainings, and identifying and assisting with process efficiencies to ensure the Department's private stormwater permitting and inspection practices consistently adhere to local, state, and federal guidelines. Incumbent is expected to be familiar with the associated codes, ordinances and regulations to assist with research and compliance measures. The role will coordinate regularly with the Department of Public Works, the Department of Metropolitan Development, contracted vendors, and internal/external partners. This position requires a high degree of initiative and independent judgment.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The City of Indianapolis Marion County is an equal opportunity employer
. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. We value diversity in perspectives and experiences among colleagues and the residents of this city of whom we serve.

Position Responsibilities

Assists the Program Manager: Stormwater in the direct oversight of permit review staff and field inspectors responsible for floodplain, private stormwater drainage, driveways, and street construction projects.
Responsible for providing training, guidance, direction, and direct supervision of staff to ensure proper code and policy enforcement.
Responsible for staff assignments and monitoring staff productivity while identifying and implementing process improvements necessary for providing efficient and effective services.
Works cooperatively with consultants and staff to ensure the issuance of permits and scheduled inspections occur timely and in compliance.
Interacts regularly with residents, contractors, developers, and other agencies to address permitting or field related inquiries.
Assists in the development, maintenance and tracking of permitting and inspection data required for use in regular and annual reporting.
Regularly performs field inspections to assess the quality of inspections performed by staff and/or when workload demands.
Responsible for reviewing violation cases for accuracy and assisting with legal case file preparation when applicable.
Investigates employee accidents or injuries and prepares associated reports.
Demonstrates continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide quality seamless customer service.
Ensures staff follow all safety procedures as outlined in the Employee Safety Handbook.
Provides expert witness testimony on behalf of the City in legal proceedings.
This position supervises ASFME Union staff, as well as non-union staff, and must ensure staff are adhering to both the HR City-County Handbook guidelines as well as the latest edition of the AFSME Union contract, as applicable.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in related field of study and two (2) years’ related work experience in construction or related industry. Five (5) years of related experience may be substituted for the formal education. Must have an ability to understand and interpret construction plans, as-builts, and stormwater and drainage designs. Must have knowledge of applicable local, state, and federal regulations within subject area. Must be able to obtain any position-specific certifications. Must have an understanding of the city’s permitting process, especially the permits specific to stormwater and drainage projects. Must have ability to communicate effectively and professionally, both orally and in writing, on technical or complex matters with inspectors, internal peers, contractors, and public. Experience managing and/or working with union-represented staff preferred.

If your qualifications meet the requirements of the posted position, your application will be referred to the hiring agency. Once the agency receives your application, all further communication during the interview and selection process will be handled directly BY THE AGENCY . City-County HR will not have access to this information, is not involved in the interview or selection process, and can only confirm whether an application has been referred. After selection of the successful candidate, an official offer of employment will be made by HR.

Maintain existing client relationships and develop relationships with prospective/new clients

jobs.description:
Our Values

In line with our One Coventry Values, we want to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organisation that encourages diversity in all respects, including diversity of thinking. We particularly welcome applicants from minority ethnic, LGBT+, disabled and neurodiverse communities to make a real difference to our residents so that equity and respect remains at the heart of everything we do.

Our Values are:

Open and fair: We are fair, open, and transparent.
Nurture and develop: We help and encourage everyone to be their best and do their best.
Engage and empower: We talk and listen to others, working together as one.
Create and innovate: We embrace new ways of working to continuously improve.
Own and be accountable: We work together to deliver the best services for our residents.
Value and respect: We put diversity and inclusion at the heart of all we do.

Coventry City Council’s Digital Services team is responsible for delivering key enabling and transformational services for the wider organisation, city and external partners. We support the day-to-day operation of the Council whilst also innovating and enabling the organisational transformation that is required.

Our Technology teams ensure that our core technology offering meets the needs of the organisation whilst planning and innovating our technology road map to keep the Council and wider city fit for the future.

Our Digital Delivery teams comprise customer and change functions that ensure we continually understand the overall organisational and wider City’s demands for digital, change and innovation and manage this delivery to our end users.

What is the job role?

This role supports the delivery of our Technology Enabled Change programme, which is an opportunity for us the change the way we work together and use technology to enhance and accelerate service delivery.

Working in a team of five Digital Business Analysts, this is a key role to the delivery of effective digital change. You will be the bridge between Council services and the Digital Team, reviewing and analysing processes and systems, identifying opportunities for improvement and supporting the delivery of efficient, customer-focussed solutions.

This involves working closely with stakeholders and technical teams across all departments, exploring options, understanding and gathering requirements, developing proposals and process and system design models, whilst ensuring that projects align with the Council’s strategic objectives and regulatory obligations.

This is a hybrid role, typically 2 days a week onsite.

All candidates must have the Right to Work in the UK. We are currently not offering sponsorship for this role.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with a passion for technology and innovation, with excellent communication skills, who solves problems with curiosity, creativity and an openness to ideas.

You understand the importance of designing services around the needs of those who use them and have delivered effective digital processes and systems that have added value.

You will hold the British Computer Society International Diploma in Business Analysis, or equivalent practitioner level qualification in business analysis.

If you need help or support to complete your application, please visit our accessibility page to see how we can assist you.

Guaranteed Interview Scheme
- As part of our commitment to inclusion, we offer guaranteed interviews for specific groups of people. To qualify, you'll need to meet the minimum requirements for the role and identify with one of the below criteria:

Members of the Armed Forces and veterans
Are currently in care or have previously been in care
If you consider yourself to be disabled or if you have a long-term health condition

For full details on the application process please read the attached document on our jobs page labelled 'Coventry City Council Application Process'. We recognise that you might use AI tools to help with your application. While these tools can be useful, please make sure that all information you provide about your experience, skills, and qualifications is accurate. What matters most to us is hearing about your experience and the achievements that truly reflect you!

Interviews will be held onsite at our offices in Coventry on 1 October 2026.

About Coventry

Coventry has a proud, innovative and creative spirit that throughout its history has seen communities come together to tackle problems and bring about real social change.

We are cutting-edge, challenging, youthful, vibrant and diverse.

At Coventry we are committed to excellence in everything we do. With around 5100 staff from a range of different backgrounds, our aim is to recruit and develop talented people who will focus on our customers, take responsibility, work together and find better ways of doing things.

To deliver the best services to our residents, we need the best people working for us to make a difference to our communities.

If you join us, we will provide a fantastic rewards and benefits package - to find out more please visit https://www.coventry.gov.uk/council-vacancies

jobs.title: Delivery Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

CHAMP Cargosystems provides the most comprehensive range of integrated IT solutions and distribution services for the air cargo transport chain. Our portfolio spans core management systems, messaging services, and eCargo solutions. These include applications designed to meet customs and security requirements, quality optimization, as well as e-freight and mobility needs. Our products and services are recognized globally under the Cargospot and Traxon brands.

We serve over 200 airlines and GSAs, connecting them with approximately 3,000 forwarders and GHAs worldwide. Our solutions help customers, and their clients, adapt to the critical and ongoing changes in air transport logistics and meet the demands of global trade.

Headquartered in Luxembourg, CHAMP Cargosystems operates offices in London, Zurich, Frankfurt, Manila, Singapore, and Atlanta.

** This role is under COO Office - Delivery Department**

The Delivery Business Analyst
is responsible for identifying and understanding customers' business issues and processes, defining and documenting customer needs, and providing functional requirements and expertise for translating these needs into CHAMP solutions. The Business Analyst ensures that solutions comply with CHAMP's processes, validates and enhances customer requirements, manages change requests, and propose technical solutions and pricing models to meet business requirements, thereby ensuring financial profitability and supporting business growth.

Accountable for a documented, feasible and costed solution position that Sales can carry to the customer and Delivery can execute without reinterpretation.

Location:
Spain (Preferred)
While Spain is the preferred location for this role, we embrace a flexible approach and welcome applications from talented professionals based in the United Kingdom, Luxembourg subject to local employment requirements.

Responsibilities :

Be the primary interface for salespersons to support customers’ engagements on technical & commercial matters.
Analyze and document customer requirements and business process.
Work with customers to better understand their business models and develop sound solution design to meet the customer's requirements.
Provide customers with comprehensive, up-to-date information on CHAMP products, product enhancements, and new solutions, through customer meetings and workshops.
Support the technical qualification of customers' communication and data exchange needs through knowledge of current new or evolving technologies and CHAMP solution portfolios.
Identify and recommend sound solutions built through CHAMP portfolio of products to meet customers’ demands.
Liaise with various internal stakeholders to determine effort, feasibility, scheduling, etc. Provide input to bid team for pre-sales activities (e.g., customer proposals generation, risk analysis, pricing, customer presentations, work breakdown structures etc.) ultimately to build business case for customer proposals.
Work closely with project managers to ensure efficient transfer of projects for implementation.
Facilitate designs to be efficiently implemented Right the First Time (RFT) and smoothly transitioned into service operation.
Act as functional subject matter expert on the air cargo operational processes in scope for the engagement, including but not limited to booking and capacity management, export and import handling, documentation and customs, rating, and billing.
Perform structured fit-gap analysis against the standard product offering and record, for each gap, the operational consequence of not meeting it, so that scope decisions rest on business impact rather than customer preference.
Challenge requirements that describe the customer's existing system rather than the customer's business need and reformulate them in process terms.
Maintain a traceable line from each requirement to its source stakeholder and to the solution element that satisfies it.
Produce clear specifications that a build team can execute.
Document to a standard that supports later audit and contractual reference without rework.
For smaller and medium projects, support the customer in preparing the test scenarios, Coordinate securing of test data from client for build testing and user acceptance testing.
Assemble and maintain the conformance evidence: requirement, design decision, build output, test result, that supports the solution gating across project stages.
Deliver customer familiarization training on the standard solution before solution design begins.
Deliver key user training ahead of user acceptance testing, so the customer's users can test the solution.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities :

Customer focused.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in diverse groups at various levels of the organization.
Domain: fluency in the air cargo operational processes in scope, independent of any specific system.
Analytical: structured fit-gap analysis, with the consequence of each gap articulated rather than listed. Traceability: every requirement linked to a source and to the element that satisfies it.
Facilitation: run workshops that reach decisions, with a named owner and a recorded rationale per open point.
Commercial judgement: where two routes meet the same requirement, selects the more time- and cost-efficient one, and can explain the basis of the choice.
Excellence: distinguishes what the customer asked for from what the customer needs, and records both; documentation is audit-ready by default; raises the scope of the question early rather than deciding beyond authority.
Team skills: hands work to engineers and QA so the receiver can act unaided.
Leadership: reviews the work of others; develops the grades below.
Achieve and maintain internal Cargospot Neo product certification once appointed.
Ability to work independently.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, Power BI is a plus.

Education and Experience :

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Mathematics, Business or Engineering.
+5 years’ experience in business analysis including experience of building user cases.
Demonstrable subject matter expertise in air cargo operational processes, including but not limited to booking and capacity, export and import handling, documentation and customs, rating and billing, or revenue accounting, with depth in at least one area.
Participation in all phases of at least one full software implementation lifecycle for an external customer, from requirements through to go-live.
Experience producing functional specifications.

The selected candidate may be subject to the provision of an up-to-date (not older than 3 months) criminal record certificate.

Security : the successful candidate will have to comply with CHAMP Security Requirements (including but not limited to CHAMP’s IT Security Policies, especially the ISMS Policy and the Acceptable Use Policy, mandatory courses, confidentiality and data protection, use of company assets, and incident reporting).

jobs.title: Junior Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Junior Business Analyst to help our team evaluate the financial health and expansion plans of a regional fintech provider currently scaling its operations. This role is a chance to dig into commercial data and test whether the growth assumptions behind their strategy reflect real market conditions.

About Blue Oak Consulting

Blue Oak Consulting provides independent advisory on pricing, portfolio economics, capital allocation, and acquisition assumptions. We are not a traditional consulting firm focused on broad transformation programs or high level strategy decks. Instead, we interrogate specific commercial decisions where the financial stakes are high and the existing narrative is not sufficient. Our team looks past corporate language and P&L complexity to identify where value is leaking or capital is trapped.
We work across sectors like software, manufacturing, and healthcare to test whether the assumptions behind a growth plan or an acquisition actually hold under pressure. We are a small, principal led firm where the people who do the work are the ones accountable for the results. We do not take transaction contingent fees, which allows us to be completely honest about whether the economics of a decision make sense. Our goal is to provide clarity through financial discipline and a healthy amount of skepticism. We stay through the execution phase because decisions that look sound in theory often fail when they meet real world friction.

The Role

As a Junior Business Analyst, you will work closely with our senior partners to examine the data that drives big corporate decisions. This is a fully remote position that requires a high degree of focus and the ability to find patterns in large datasets. You will not be making slide decks for the sake of appearances. Your work will focus on understanding how money moves through a business, where costs are hidden, and whether a company financial model matches its actual performance. We value accuracy and the ability to ask the right questions over following a set script.

What You Will Be Doing
Reviewing financial statements and operational data to verify growth claims for the fintech client.
Building and maintaining spreadsheet models to forecast different business scenarios.
Checking the consistency of data across various reports from the client and their subsidiaries.
Helping the team identify risks in capital allocation strategies and investment plans.
Preparing clear summaries of findings that highlight discrepancies or areas of concern.
Tracking the progress of execution plans to see if they meet the original financial goals.
Participating in internal meetings to discuss the validity of pricing structures and unit economics.
Conducting research on market trends that might affect a client portfolio economics.

What You Bring
A university degree in finance, economics, business, or a related field.
Comfort working with numbers and a basic understanding of financial reporting and P&L structures.
Strong proficiency in Excel, including the ability to organize and clean large datasets.
A curious mindset that naturally questions why things are done a certain way.
High attention to detail, especially when reviewing long documents or complex spreadsheets.
The ability to work independently and manage your own schedule in a remote setting.
Clear written communication skills for explaining complex data in plain English.
A willingness to learn our specific approach to interrogation and financial discipline.

What We Offer
A permanent, full-time position with a competitive pay structure for the market and this level.
The flexibility of a fully remote work environment, giving you control over your space.
Direct access to senior partners who will provide guidance and feedback on your work.
Hands-on experience with high-stakes financial advisory projects from the start.
A culture that values evidence and logic over corporate hierarchy or titles.
Professional development through real-world analysis rather than theoretical training modules.
Exposure to various industries beyond just the current fintech engagement.

We believe that the best financial advice comes from people who are willing to look at the facts without bias. At Blue Oak Consulting, we do not aim to be the biggest firm, but we strive to be the most reliable source of clarity for our clients. By joining our team, you will learn how to peel back the layers of a business and see what is really happening underneath. This is a role for someone who finds satisfaction in getting the numbers right and understanding the economic truth of a situation.

This is a third-party position. The selected individual will be employed by Knowledge Services, not directly by the City of Indianapolis. Knowledge Services is a workforce management and solutions company headquartered in Indianapolis, IN, with more than 25 years of experience. All employment benefits will be provided through Knowledge Services.**********************

The Construction Manager oversees residential rehabilitation projects funded through government-sponsored and City of Indianapolis programs, ensuring safe, code-compliant, timely, and cost-effective repairs and upgrades to owner-occupied homes. This role involves managing multiple projects simultaneously, coordinating with contractors, inspectors, homeowners, and program staff to ensure timely and compliant project delivery.

Agency Summary

The purpose and mission of the Department of Metropolitan Development works to shape the city’s identity by strengthening all people and places, building upon our history, and fostering visionary development. The DMD agency envisions the city as a growing, vibrant, equitable, and beautiful city where people and businesses thrive in an inclusive and innovative community. The agency is able to do this by cultivating a productive, collaborative, and compliant work environment in order for our workforce to meet the needs of the residents of Indianapolis and Marion County.

Equal Employment Opportunity

The City of Indianapolis Marion County is an equal opportunity employer
. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. We value diversity in perspectives and experiences among colleagues and the residents of this city of whom we serve.

Position Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Manage the full construction cycle of residential rehab projects, from bidding through Certificate of Completion.
Interpret cost estimates, scopes, specifications of work, and bid packages for contractor solicitation and being able to convey to homeowners
Use software Rehab Spec (RHS) introduced by DMD to manage all aspects of project management, participant interactions/progress from program interest to final service delivery, updating milestone status at each step.
Manage the Contractor information for Licenses, Insurance etc ensuring timely updates in RHS.
Collaborate with program staff to ensure eligibility, funding limits, and documentation requirements are met.
Coordinate and supervise contractors, ensuring adherence to project specifications, timelines, and budgets.
Monitor construction progress through site visits, inspections, and regular reporting.
Resolve construction issues, initiate Change Orders, and homeowner concerns in a timely and professional manner.

Maintain Contractor profiles for Insurance, Licenses and expiration dates in Rehab Spec
Promote safety and quality standards on all job sites.
Meet at least weekly with the Home Repair Team to discuss projects and progress – in person or telephone. Daily touch points with Manager.

This list of duties and responsibilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties or responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.
Registered LLC owner preferred.
5+ years of experience in residential construction or rehabilitation, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or project management role.
Knowledge of federal, state, and local housing rehab programs (e.g., CDBG, HOME, Weatherization, Lead Hazard Control) strongly preferred.

Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills.

Certifications such as NSPIRE, Lead Renovator (RRP), OSHA 10/30, or ICC Residential Inspector are a plus.

Field-based role with frequent travel to residential job sites.

Must be able to work in varying weather conditions and environments, including occupied homes.
Some lifting, carrying, pushing and/or pulling of objects and materials of light weight (5-10) pounds.
Tasks require the ability to perceive and hear sounds and see visual cues or signals.
Tasks require the ability to communicate orally.

Gather and organize commercial data on counterparties and market participants within the territory.

Monitor regulatory updates and news that could impact the commercial standing of our clients.

Self-discipline to work effectively in a fully remote setting without needing constant supervision.
The ability to follow research leads and stay focused on finding the ground reality of a situation.
Comfort with receiving direct feedback and refining your work to meet high professional standards.

Direct exposure to senior partners who are involved in high-level negotiations and regulator conversations.
The opportunity to see how data analysis directly influences the outcome of multi-million dollar investments.
A competitive and attractive salary for this entry-level role, reflecting its importance to our firm.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Clerk Grade 7/8, Wollongong or Rhodes
jobs.description:
Business Analyst, Clerk Grade 7/8, Wollongong or Rhodes

Join us in advancing public safety, digital innovation, and Operational Systems
Work in a volunteer-based agency supporting communities of NSW
Full-time temporary role 30 June 2028, with a potential extension based on future funding outcomes
Based in Rhodes or Wollongong, with flexible working arrangements available

About the opportunity

Join the NSW SES as a Business Analyst and play a crucial role in driving business improvements and enhancing operational efficiency. This is a newly established team responsible for leading digital delivery across the organisation's operational systems portfolio. We are building a contemporary product management and digital delivery capability that partners closely with operational stakeholders to deliver user centred, reliable and innovative solutions. The focus for this role is on strengthening governance, improving operational capability, and enabling frontline emergency services through modern, fit for purpose technology.

Working within a dynamic technical and operational environment, you will collaborate with volunteers, stakeholders and technical teams to understand business needs, analyse existing processes and identify opportunities to improve the way we deliver services. You will lead business analysis activities that support the enhancement of existing operational systems and the implementation of new digital capabilities, ensuring solutions align with organisational priorities and deliver measurable business value.

You will be responsible for documenting business requirements, facilitating workshops, mapping current and future state business processes, coordinating testing, and developing practical recommendations that support informed decision making. As the primary point of contact for operational systems enquiries, you will also manage Service Desk requests, build trusted relationships with stakeholders and volunteers, and provide responsive, customer focused support to ensure issues are resolved effectively.

This role is based at the NSW SES State Headquarters in Wollongong or in Rhodes, while some flexible working arrangements are available, this role requires you to work from the office often to ensure effective collaboration and support for project activities. Some out of hour's work may be required, including weekends and nights.

About the NSW SES

Our Mission: NSW SES saving lives and creating safer communities.
Our Vision: A trusted volunteer-based emergency service, working together to deliver excellence in community preparedness and emergency response.

The NSW SES serves the community as the lead agency for Floods, Storms and Tsunamis. We are recognised as the most versatile and widely used emergency service organisation in NSW. Our volunteers are highly skilled, experienced, and well- trained in the wide variety of roles they perform.

With over 10,000 volunteers we are committed to protecting and supporting the diverse communities of NSW. Learn more here.

About you

To be successful in this role you will:

demonstrate experience in business analysis, business process improvement and solution design within a technical or complex service delivery environment;
have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify business needs and develop practical, evidence-based solutions;
have excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with volunteers, business representatives and technical teams;
demonstrate strong customer focus, with experience managing enquiries and delivering responsive, high quality service in a fast paced operational environment; and
have experience documenting business requirements, facilitating workshops and mapping current and future state business processes.

What we can offer you

You will enjoy a 35-hour work week, with the potential for flexible work arrangements.
You can enjoy a hybrid work environment, time in the office and time working from home.
Attractive salary range $116,981 - $129,492 plus 12% superannuation and leave loading.
Our work is meaningful and rewarding. The SES’s mission is saving lives and creating safer communities and you can be an important part of our work.
We have attractive leave entitlements including parental, sick, flex and recreation leave.
We care about our people. We have Mental Health & Wellbeing programs and services to support our people and operational and leadership training and development opportunities to develop our people. Some of these include:
Fitness Passport
LinkedIn Learning
Member Assist Program for free confidential counselling support
Immunisation program.

You belong here

We care about people as individuals and are committed to diversity, inclusion, and new ways of working. We encourage applications from people of any age, gender, ethnicity, cultural background, faith, disability, sexual orientation or gender identity.
We want our people to reflect the diverse community we serve and are committed to creating an inclusive and flexible workplace. We want to know what this looks like for you so we can support your success at work.
If you require reasonable adjustments, we are committed to supporting you throughout the recruitment processes and in the workplace. If you feel you may require an adjustment during the recruitment process, please contact recruitment@ses.nsw.gov.au for confidential advice on options.

How to apply

Your application should include as separate attachments:

Responses to the three target questions
below, maximum of 2 pages.
An up-to-date resume
of no more than four pages detailing your skills and experience relevant to the role.

A cover letter is not required.

Targeted questions

Customer and stakeholder engagement:
This role requires regular engagement with volunteers and stakeholders and serves as a key point of contact for operational systems enquiries. Describe your approach to delivering high-quality customer service, including how you build relationships, manage competing priorities, and ensure enquiries are resolved in a timely and professional manner.
Business analysis and solution design:
Describe your approach to business analysis, from understanding a business problem through developing and presenting a recommended solution. Include how you engage stakeholders, gather and validate requirements, analyse options and communicate recommendations to both technical and non technical audiences.
Continuous improvement and change:
Provide an example of a business improvement initiative you have led or significantly contributed to. Describe the problem, your analysis, the solution you recommended and implemented, how you managed stakeholder engagement, and the outcome achieved.

If you want to know more about this opportunity, please contact Senior Manager, Digital Delivery, Krish Goundar on krishneel.goundar@ses.nsw.gov.au

jobs.title: Junior Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Finance teams often struggle when their reporting systems are built without a clear understanding of the monthly close process. At Alpine Business Consulting, we bridge the gap between finance logic and technical configuration. We are currently supporting a partner in Paris on a project that requires rigorous data alignment and system remediation, ensuring their financial tools actually serve the needs of the accounting team rather than creating more manual work.

About the role

As a Junior Research Analyst, you will support our team in delivering high quality, fixed price consulting projects. This role is focused on the practical side of finance systems, helping to map out data flows and document configurations. You will work in a fully remote environment, collaborating with consultants to fix broken configurations and build out analytics models that provide clear, accurate numbers. Your work is central to our promise of making clients self sufficient, as you will help create the documentation and training materials that allow them to manage their own systems long after our engagement ends.

What you will do
Assist in documenting the existing close process and chart of accounts for our partner in Paris.
Clean and organize large datasets to ensure they are ready for system implementation or remediation.
Build and maintain data dictionaries that define exactly how financial metrics are calculated across the organization.
Support the configuration of reporting modules by verifying settings against client requirements.
Conduct reconciliation tests to ensure system outputs match historical financial records.
Draft clear, technical documentation for system administrators and end users.
Research regulatory reporting standards to ensure data models comply with local requirements.
Participate in internal reviews to identify common points of failure in finance configurations.

What we are looking for
A basic understanding of financial statements, including how the balance sheet and P&L interact.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, specifically the ability to handle complex formulas and large tables.
Basic familiarity with SQL for querying and organizing data.
A high level of precision and the ability to spot small discrepancies in financial reports.
Clear written communication skills for drafting guides and process maps.
The ability to work independently in a remote setting while staying aligned with team goals.
A pragmatic approach to problem solving that avoids unnecessary complexity.
Recent graduation or final year studies in finance, accounting, or business information systems.

Bonus points
Previous exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
Basic knowledge of Oracle EPM, SAP BPC, or similar consolidation software.
Familiarity with the specific financial reporting nuances of the DACH region.

What we offer
Full time, permanent employment in a fully remote role.
Competitive pay that is attractive for the current market and entry level seniority.
Direct mentorship from senior finance consultants who prioritize technical accuracy.
A work environment free from implementation theatre and unnecessary corporate layers.
Exposure to complex data challenges within highly regulated industries.
Consistent schedules driven by fixed price project scopes rather than open ended billing.
Continuous learning opportunities in the field of EPM and financial analytics.

Our approach is always finance first. We do not believe in implementing technology for its own sake: we believe in building systems that work for the people who use them every day. By focusing on the chart of accounts and the close process before touching the software, we ensure that our clients receive a tool they can actually trust. Every project we take on is designed to end with the client being entirely self sufficient, equipped with the training and documentation they need to succeed without ongoing external support.

With a consolidated turnover of €5,683 million and an EBITDA of €1,080 million, along with a workforce of over 7,627 dedicated individuals, we drive success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.

We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, creating a lasting impact. At METLEN, we foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.

Metlen Energy & Metals is a global industrial and energy company covering two business sectors: Energy and Metals. Through our M Renewables Division, we develop, construct and operate utility-scale renewable energy projects across international markets, supporting the global transition to clean energy.

As our renewable portfolio continues to grow across the UK, we are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of utility-scale Solar PV projects from pre-construction through to commissioning and handover.

Reporting to the Projects Director, you will take full responsibility for delivering utility-scale solar EPC projects safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with engineering, construction, procurement, finance and HSE teams, you will coordinate all aspects of project execution while managing relationships with clients, subcontractors and suppliers.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced renewable energy professional who enjoys leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the delivery of utility-scale Solar PV projects from project mobilisation through to completion and handover.
Manage project scope, programme, budget, quality and commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop and maintain detailed project programmes and monitor progress against key milestones.
Coordinate internal engineering, procurement, construction and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution.
Review technical documentation and collaborate with engineering teams to optimise project designs.
Support project budgeting, forecasting, cost control and financial reporting.
Manage subcontractor procurement, tender evaluations and contract administration.
Oversee site teams and subcontractors, ensuring works are completed safely and efficiently.
Monitor project risks and implement mitigation strategies to minimise programme and commercial impacts.
Ensure full compliance with company Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QHSE) standards.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, developers, suppliers and key stakeholders.
Prepare regular project progress reports for both internal management and clients.
Coordinate project commissioning activities and successful handover to the Operations & Maintenance team.

What We're Looking For:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil Engineering (or a related engineering discipline).
Minimum 5 years' experience delivering medium to large-scale utility Solar PV EPC projects (5MW+).
Proven experience managing renewable energy projects through the full EPC lifecycle.
Strong knowledge of construction management, project controls and contract administration.
Experience managing project budgets, schedules and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
Excellent organisational, planning and problem-solving abilities.
