new_jobs.title: Junior Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Finance teams often struggle when their reporting systems are built without a clear understanding of the monthly close process. At Alpine Business Consulting, we bridge the gap between finance logic and technical configuration. We are currently supporting a partner in Paris on a project that requires rigorous data alignment and system remediation, ensuring their financial tools actually serve the needs of the accounting team rather than creating more manual work.

About the role

As a Junior Research Analyst, you will support our team in delivering high quality, fixed price consulting projects. This role is focused on the practical side of finance systems, helping to map out data flows and document configurations. You will work in a fully remote environment, collaborating with consultants to fix broken configurations and build out analytics models that provide clear, accurate numbers. Your work is central to our promise of making clients self sufficient, as you will help create the documentation and training materials that allow them to manage their own systems long after our engagement ends.

What you will do
Assist in documenting the existing close process and chart of accounts for our partner in Paris.
Clean and organize large datasets to ensure they are ready for system implementation or remediation.
Build and maintain data dictionaries that define exactly how financial metrics are calculated across the organization.
Support the configuration of reporting modules by verifying settings against client requirements.
Conduct reconciliation tests to ensure system outputs match historical financial records.
Draft clear, technical documentation for system administrators and end users.
Research regulatory reporting standards to ensure data models comply with local requirements.
Participate in internal reviews to identify common points of failure in finance configurations.

What we are looking for
A basic understanding of financial statements, including how the balance sheet and P&L interact.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, specifically the ability to handle complex formulas and large tables.
Basic familiarity with SQL for querying and organizing data.
A high level of precision and the ability to spot small discrepancies in financial reports.
Clear written communication skills for drafting guides and process maps.
The ability to work independently in a remote setting while staying aligned with team goals.
A pragmatic approach to problem solving that avoids unnecessary complexity.
Recent graduation or final year studies in finance, accounting, or business information systems.

Bonus points
Previous exposure to Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
Basic knowledge of Oracle EPM, SAP BPC, or similar consolidation software.
Familiarity with the specific financial reporting nuances of the DACH region.

What we offer
Full time, permanent employment in a fully remote role.
Competitive pay that is attractive for the current market and entry level seniority.
Direct mentorship from senior finance consultants who prioritize technical accuracy.
A work environment free from implementation theatre and unnecessary corporate layers.
Exposure to complex data challenges within highly regulated industries.
Consistent schedules driven by fixed price project scopes rather than open ended billing.
Continuous learning opportunities in the field of EPM and financial analytics.

Our approach is always finance first. We do not believe in implementing technology for its own sake: we believe in building systems that work for the people who use them every day. By focusing on the chart of accounts and the close process before touching the software, we ensure that our clients receive a tool they can actually trust. Every project we take on is designed to end with the client being entirely self sufficient, equipped with the training and documentation they need to succeed without ongoing external support.

new_jobs.description:
Metlen Energy & Metals is a global industrial and energy company covering two business Sectors: Energy and Metallurgy. The Company is strategically positioned at the forefront of the energy transition as an integrated utility, while already established as a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at the European and global level. It has a consolidated turnover and EBITDA of €5,492 million and €1,014 million, respectively, and employs more than 6,583 direct and indirect employees in Greece and abroad. At METLEN Energy & Metals, we are catalysts for a sustainable future, positioned at the forefront of the energy transition while being a reference point for competitive green metallurgy at both the European and global levels. We are a global industrial and energy company operating across two highly interconnected and complementary sectors: Energy and Metals. With a consolidated turnover of €5,683 million and an EBITDA of €1,080 million, along with a workforce of over 7,627 dedicated individuals, we drive success through cutting-edge technology and diverse talent.

We are committed to embracing new state-of-the-art technologies and advancements, propelling us towards a cleaner, brighter tomorrow. Our positive footprint extends across five continents, creating a lasting impact. At METLEN, we foster a culture of resilience, challenge, respect, excellence, and change, empowering our diverse workforce to achieve remarkable outcomes.

Metlen Energy & Metals is a global industrial and energy company covering two business sectors: Energy and Metals. Through our M Renewables Division, we develop, construct and operate utility-scale renewable energy projects across international markets, supporting the global transition to clean energy.

As our renewable portfolio continues to grow across the UK, we are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of utility-scale Solar PV projects from pre-construction through to commissioning and handover.

Reporting to the Projects Director, you will take full responsibility for delivering utility-scale solar EPC projects safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with engineering, construction, procurement, finance and HSE teams, you will coordinate all aspects of project execution while managing relationships with clients, subcontractors and suppliers.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced renewable energy professional who enjoys leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the delivery of utility-scale Solar PV projects from project mobilisation through to completion and handover.
Manage project scope, programme, budget, quality and commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop and maintain detailed project programmes and monitor progress against key milestones.
Coordinate internal engineering, procurement, construction and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution.
Review technical documentation and collaborate with engineering teams to optimise project designs.
Support project budgeting, forecasting, cost control and financial reporting.
Manage subcontractor procurement, tender evaluations and contract administration.
Oversee site teams and subcontractors, ensuring works are completed safely and efficiently.
Monitor project risks and implement mitigation strategies to minimise programme and commercial impacts.
Ensure full compliance with company Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QHSE) standards.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients, developers, suppliers and key stakeholders.
Prepare regular project progress reports for both internal management and clients.
Coordinate project commissioning activities and successful handover to the Operations & Maintenance team.

What We're Looking For:

Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil Engineering (or a related engineering discipline).
Minimum 5 years' experience delivering medium to large-scale utility Solar PV EPC projects (5MW+).
Proven experience managing renewable energy projects through the full EPC lifecycle.
Strong knowledge of construction management, project controls and contract administration.
Experience managing project budgets, schedules and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills.
Excellent organisational, planning and problem-solving abilities.
Working knowledge of MS Project and Microsoft Office.
Full UK driving licence.

At Metlen Energy & Metals, you'll become part of a collaborative international organisation delivering some of Europe's most exciting renewable energy projects.

We offer:

Competitive salary and performance-based benefits.
Private global healthcare.
Company pension scheme.
Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
Exposure to large-scale renewable energy projects across international markets.
A collaborative, innovative and inclusive working environment where your expertise can make a real impact.

Follow us on LinkedIn and stay updated on our latest news

We respect your personal data. All personal information in your application and CV will remain strictly confidential.

At Metlen Energy & Metals we are proud to have Diversity and Inclusion at the centre of everything we do. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity regardless of race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or religion.

new_jobs.title: Physical Security Technical Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

ZBeta is a world-class physical security design, consulting, and managed services firm that partners with some of the most dynamic, high-profile organizations and individuals in the world. We leverage a Data-Driven, Technology-Led, Human-Centered approach in order to help our clients architect and engineer superior physical security solutions, implement them seamlessly, and operate them at peak efficiency. ZBeta prides itself on its level of technical expertise but remains independent and product-agnostic. Our highly experienced team brings decades of security expertise, diverse organizational perspectives, and proven best practices to every project and customer. It is our meticulous attention to detail and our ability to deliver at scale that positions us to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Our primary goal is to redefine the standards of professional security, equipping our clients with innovative tools to master today’s challenges and fortify against tomorrow's risks. By consistently delivering exceptional solutions and pioneering advancements in the security field, we can exceed expectations and set new standards of excellence in pursuing our vision.

Find out more about us here .

WHO YOU ARE:

You are a forward-thinking strategic partner with a passion for enhancing security measures and fostering community resilience. You excel in fast-paced settings where your leadership abilities can catalyze meaningful transformation. You thrive in a workplace culture that is:
Innovative
Strives for Excellence
Reliable
Detail Oriented
Adaptable
Highly Organized
Client Obsessed
Curious
Resilient

Does this sound like you? If so, join us in our mission to redefine security standards and make a lasting difference in our community.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Technical Project Manager
, you will be responsible for supporting security design and installation projects throughout North, South, and Central America, including new sites and expansion projects, post-occupancy projects, and technology upgrade projects. The Technical Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of project delivery, including collaborating with key stakeholders, managing multiple projects, and scopes of work.

You are a resourceful, knowledgeable, and self-motivated security professional who thrives in a collaborative and supportive environment.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Growth Minded:
Strong self-awareness of strengths and development areas with a curiosity and appetite for change and innovation
Adaptable:
Ability to adjust to changing circumstances, conditions, and tasks quickly and effectively
Collaborative:
Ability to solicit and understand multiple perspectives
Evaluative:
Ability to evaluate outputs rigorously to ensure consistent excellence in delivery
Accountable:
Assumes responsibility for successfully accomplishing work objectives and delivering results; setting high standards of performance for self and others

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

The essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to the following:

Project Management

Identify project schedule, scope parameters, and oversee security design and implementation per client design requirements and standards.
Manage early project initiation activities and develop project security scope, schedule, critical deliverables, and requirements.
Manage scheduling, status, and tracking of critical project tasks, issues, and deliverables.
Assist with the bid and award process. Review bid leveling documentation and provide feedback on the award recommendation.
Evaluate SOW responses and prepare evaluation reports, to include evaluation criteria, scoring, and recommendation details.

Design

Perform security site evaluations of potential client properties and review proposed design concepts.
Apply client system design standards to in-progress site design, collaborate with client owner and user group stakeholders to define use cases and verify functional requirements, and produce a security functional specification for the project.
Review all security system design documentation for compliance with published security requirements, technical standards, and installation standards.
Review VAR requests for equipment substitutions and scope variances and provide recommendations for approval.
Redline documentation with corrections and log issues, as required.

Client Relationship

Accountable for keeping clients informed of project status, including budget, schedule, risks, issues, and successes, and managing the client's expectations around the project design through individual and project team member communication.

Collaborate

Serve as a primary security point of contact for project teams and stakeholders.
Attend regular project design, project management, Owner/Architect/Contractor (OAC), and construction meetings.
Manage site activation activities for physical security amongst project parties and stakeholders to drive schedule, quality, and cost.
Assist in the coordination of other trades required to complete the project including Contractor, Electrical, IT, etc.

Documentation

Produce project status and issues reports and meet with client stakeholders weekly to review and resolve high-priority project issues.
Log all instances of issue resolutions that constitute exceptions to the published client security requirements to facilitate effective requirements exceptions reporting and/or requirement document updates.

Quality Control

Conduct on-site inspections during construction and installation and final acceptance testing of completed systems installation.
Manage project lessons learned, site metrics evaluation, and contractor performance evaluations.
Review all security system design documentation produced by the system designer for compliance with published security requirements, technical standards, and installation standards.
Oversee the delivery of all shop drawings and close-out documentation required from the integrator/contractor.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Experience:
5+ years of project management experience, with a significant portion of tenure spent as a consultant, integrator, or technical end user.
Education:
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
Knowledge:

Detailed knowledge of access control system hardware, wiring standards/practices, installation methods, and programming required
Experience working on corporate office core/shell and tenant fit-out projects is preferred.

Skills:

Basic knowledge of Lenel OnGuard, with experience performing monitoring functions and simple programming changes is a plus. Certification in either S2 or Lenel Access Control Systems is preferred.
Highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Office software
Proficiency in Bluebeam, AutoCAD, Revit, or other design tools is a plus
Proficiency in project management tools, such as MS Project, SharePoint, and QuickBase

Abilities:

Demonstrated excellence in communicating and presenting complex information to technical and non-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in written form
Demonstrated ability to follow and implement client design and installation standards, and to serve as an advocate for those standards when working with external design teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, which may range from small moves/adds/changes to large new site construction projects.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive salary based on job-related skills, experience, and qualifications
Our excellent benefits package includes 100% paid premiums on health, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401k retirement plan, paid time off, and more
Diverse and supportive culture

WHAT'S IMPORTANT TO KNOW

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of Sunnyvale, CA, USA
This position is an embedded position with a minimum of 3 days/week in-office requirements and will work directly with our client
This position requires the ability to travel internationally up to 20%
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship
Candidates must be able to meet client and/or government security screening requirements for the role
This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide proof of citizenship.
The successful completion of a background check is required upon hire and every two years thereafter

We look forward to connecting with individuals who are passionate about our mission and can bring diverse contributions to our team — not just those who check all the boxes.

We are committed to creating a supportive, encouraging environment where everyone can fully express their diverse perspectives, showcase their talents, and grow their knowledge, skills, and abilities.

The base pay offered will depend on factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. At ZBeta, new hires are rarely placed at the top of the pay range; compensation is determined by the specific circumstances of each position and candidate.

A note to third-party recruiters - we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
